record: Republic of Myanmar UNESCO Bagan nomination, monument IMP 2171
facts: Ananda has four entrance halls, layered sloping roofs and square terraces, corner stupas, and a central gilded spire. It is predominantly brick masonry with stucco, stone details and decorative glazed plaques.

record: The Ananda Temple at Pagan measured survey
facts: The square temple basement measures about 175 feet along a side. Four porches project roughly 57 feet each, making a cross of about 290 feet per axis.

record: Myanmar’s permanent mission description of Ananda
facts: The central square is approximately 53 m and the protective umbrella reaches approximately 51 m above ground.
